summary.business_type: Travel / Tourism — Destination Guide & Content Hub
top_findings: All 14 detail-page canonicals point to http://localhost:4321 — this must be fixed before production deployment
No robots.txt or XML sitemap — search engines have no crawl guidance
OG image is SVG — will break social sharing previews on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn
Detail pages are orphaned from each other — only link back to homepage
No llms.txt — AI crawlers cannot efficiently discover or ingest site content
quick_wins: Fix canonical URLs in DetailLayout.astro: replace Astro.url.href with production URL
Generate a robots.txt and sitemap.xml (15 pages — static generation is trivial)
Add BreadcrumbList schema to all detail pages (breadcrumb UI already exists)
Create llms.txt and llms-full.txt for AI crawler discovery
Add fetchpriority="high" to the hero image for faster LCP

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean URL structure with descriptive paths
Responsive viewport with mobile-first design
Light CSS footprint (~45 KB across 2 files)

findings.title: Detail-page canonicals resolve to localhost
findings.description: All 14 detail pages use Astro.url.href which resolves to http://localhost:4321 during build. Google will see wrong canonicals.
findings.recommendation: Replace Astro.url.href with 'https://shangri-la-yunnan.com' + Astro.url.pathname in DetailLayout.astro and BaseLayout.astro.

findings.title: Missing robots.txt
findings.description: No robots.txt in the dist directory. Crawlers have no guidance.
findings.recommendation: Create a robots.txt in /public with Sitemap directive and appropriate allow/disallow rules.

findings.title: Missing XML sitemap
findings.description: No sitemap.xml for 15 pages. Search engines rely on sitemaps for discovery.
findings.recommendation: Install @astrojs/sitemap and add to astro.config.mjs.

findings.title: No 404 error page
findings.description: Missing 404 page degrades UX for broken links and signals poor quality to search engines.
findings.recommendation: Create src/pages/404.astro with navigation back to homepage.

findings.title: No cache or security headers
findings.description: Static hosting has no Cache-Control, X-Content-Type-Options, or HSTS headers configured.
findings.recommendation: Configure headers at CDN/hosting level (Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify).

findings.title: External render-blocking fonts
findings.description: Google Fonts Outfit loads as a blocking stylesheet, delaying first paint.
findings.recommendation: Add &display=swap parameter or self-host the font.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Comprehensive single-page coverage of all traveler needs
Substantial detail pages (10-15 KB each) with practical information
Original decision-helping content like Shangri-La vs Tibet comparison table
Freshness signal: updated August 2026

findings.title: Detail pages orphaned from each other
findings.description: Every detail page links only to /. No cross-links between related attractions or food pages.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Related Attractions' or 'You Might Also Like' sections on each detail page.

findings.title: No author or expertise signals
findings.description: No author name, bio, or About page. E-E-A-T is critical for travel content.
findings.recommendation: Add an author byline or About page with credentials.

findings.title: H1 contains HTML formatting tags
findings.description:
Homepage H1 uses
and tags, diluting semantic heading signal.
findings.recommendation: Use plain-text H1: 'Shangri-La Yunnan Travel Guide 2026'.

findings.title: Long-scroll single-page trade-off
findings.description: 131 KB single-page means weather, altitude, transport topics compete for the same title/description.
findings.recommendation: Consider spinning out high-volume topics (weather, altitude guide) as standalone pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 100% alt text coverage on all images
Keyword-rich title tags on all pages
Loading=lazy on below-fold images
Breadcrumb navigation on detail pages (UI only)

findings.title: OG image is SVG — breaks social sharing
findings.description: Social platforms (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn) do not render SVG OG images. Shares will show blank previews.
findings.recommendation: Replace og-image.svg with a 1200x630 PNG image.

findings.title: Title tags are formulaic
findings.description: All detail pages use 'Page Title | Shangri-La Yunnan Travel Guide'. Front-loading unique content would improve CTR.
findings.recommendation: Restructure to 'Unique Page Title — Key Benefit' format.

findings.title: 38 H4 tags — heading hierarchy issues
findings.description: Many card titles and labels are marked as H4 when they should be <strong> or <dt>.
findings.recommendation: Audit heading hierarchy and reduce H4 count to genuinely important sub-sections.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 5 schema types on homepage: Organization, WebSite, FAQPage, TouristDestination, ItemList
TouristAttraction schema with GeoCoordinates on all 14 detail pages
15-well-populated FAQPage items targeting real traveler queries
Accurate geo coordinates for all locations

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: Detail pages render visible breadcrumbs but have no BreadcrumbList structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to DetailLayout.astro.

findings.title: No @id cross-referencing between schemas
findings.description: Organization and TouristDestination are not linked via @id, weakening knowledge graph signal.
findings.recommendation: Add @id values and cross-reference between schema blocks.

findings.title: SearchAction target may be a dead URL
findings.description: WebSite schema references /search?q= but no search page exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement a search page or remove SearchAction.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: All images in modern .webp format
CSS hashed for cache-busting
Minimal client-side JavaScript
Leaflet map loaded lazily

findings.title: No server-side compression configured
findings.description: 131 KB homepage needs gzip/brotli compression. Without it, TTFB suffers.
findings.recommendation: Enable brotli compression at the CDN/hosting layer.

findings.title: Multiple images exceed 200 KB
findings.description: Balagezong (384 KB), Daocheng (348 KB), Lijiang (336 KB), Yubeng (308 KB), Tiger Leaping Gorge (268 KB).
findings.recommendation: Compress further or serve responsive srcset variants.

findings.title: Hero image missing fetchpriority=high
findings.description: The hero image is the LCP element but lacks priority hint.
findings.recommendation: Add fetchpriority='high' to the hero img tag.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Rich structured data makes content highly parseable by AI crawlers
Factual, structured answers to real traveler questions
Single-page format allows one-fetch content extraction

findings.title: No llms.txt or llms-full.txt
findings.description: AI crawlers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Extended) look for llms.txt to discover content for AI-generated answers.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt (index) and /llms-full.txt (full content for AI ingestion).

findings.title: No robots.txt — cannot direct AI crawlers
findings.description: Without robots.txt, you cannot selectively allow/block GPTBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, or Google-Extended.
findings.recommendation: Create robots.txt with AI crawler directives.

findings.title: Factual claims lack inline citations
findings.description: Specific claims like 'built in 1679' and '11,613 km²' have no source attribution. AI models prefer cited content.
findings.recommendation: Add source citations or links to authoritative references.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% alt text coverage (19/19 homepage images)
All images in .webp format
18/19 images use loading=lazy where appropriate
Hero image correctly omits lazy loading

findings.title: Several images exceed 200 KB
findings.description: Balagezong (384 KB), Daocheng (348 KB), Lijiang (336 KB), Yubeng (308 KB) all exceed recommended size.
findings.recommendation: Use sharper compression (quality 75-80) or serve responsive srcset variants.

findings.title: No responsive images (srcset)
findings.description: All images use fixed src with no srcset for different viewport sizes.
findings.recommendation: Generate 400w, 800w, 1200w variants and use srcset/sizes attributes.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix canonical URLs in DetailLayout.astro — replace Astro.url.href with production URL
Create robots.txt with AI crawler directives and Sitemap reference
Install @astrojs/sitemap and generate sitemap.xml
Replace og-image.svg with a 1200x630 PNG
Add fetchpriority='high' to hero image

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add BreadcrumbList schema to all detail pages
Add @id cross-referencing between schema blocks
Create llms.txt and llms-full.txt for AI crawlers
Build 404 error page
Add Related Attractions / You Might Also Like cross-links between detail pages
Compress large images (balagezong, daocheng, lijiang, yubeng, tiger-leaping-gorge)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add author byline and About page
Restructure homepage H1 to plain text
Add source citations to factual claims
Create responsive srcset for all images
Add sameAs links to Organization schema (TripAdvisor, Wikidata, etc.)
Self-host Google Fonts or add font-display: swap
Audit and reduce H4 heading count

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console and submit sitemap
Monitor CrUX data for real-user Core Web Vitals
Deploy at CDN with brotli compression and security headers
Build external citations (Wikipedia, TripAdvisor, travel media)
Consider spinning out weather and altitude guide as standalone pages if traffic warrants
Set up SEO drift monitoring for critical pages
